name: Audio Downloader
description: Adds a "Download Audio" button to the web client for movies, episodes, seasons and series. The rendered track has detected intro, outro, commercial and preview segments cut (via Jellyfin media segments as produced by the Intro Skipper plugin) and long silent periods removed. Output can be MP3 or M4A/AAC and the audio track can be chosen when multiple languages are present.
overview: Download a compressed audio track of a movie or show with intros, outros and dead air removed.

versions.changelog:
1.0.5.0 Keep the download button after client navigation: re-query the detail container after resolving the item (previously appended to a detached node after React swapped the view, hiding the button). Download via fetch so the server's error is reported instead of silently failing.
1.0.4.0 Continuously observe the route and DOM instead of listening only for #/details routes: log every route change plus the top element classes on item pages so the real detail page structure is always visible.
1.0.3.0 Make button placement adaptive: search several detail-page containers with a header fallback, re-check during client re-renders, and log a DOM probe so the active container can be identified.
1.0.2.0 Bypass browser/service worker caching of the client script: add a version query to the injected tag and no-store cache headers.
1.0.1.0 Fix download button injection for Jellyfin 10.11: place the button in the main detail button row and stop depending on legacy api client helpers.
1.0.0.0 Initial release
